meta.name: parallel-debugging
meta.description: Debug complex issues using competing hypotheses with parallel investigation, evidence collection, and root cause arbitration. Use this skill when debugging bugs with multiple potential causes, performing root cause analysis, or organizing parallel investigation workflows.

copy.tagline: 并行验证多个假设,揪出复杂 bug 的根因
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对原因不明的复杂 bug,想用并行调查法快速定位根因
copy.tagline_en: Parallelize hypothesis testing to pinpoint root causes of complex bugs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're stuck on a tricky bug with multiple possible causes and want a systematic way to find the root cause

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用竞争假设法排查复杂 bug：按 6 类失效模式生成假设、并行收集带 file:line 的证据、评定置信度，再仲裁根因并校验修复。
howto.when: 当 bug 有多个可能原因、初次排查没找到问题，或问题横跨多个模块、需要系统性根因分析时触发。

say.text: 这个 bug 可能有好几个原因，帮我并行排查根因
say.note: 它会生成竞争假设并收集证据

say.text: 用竞争假设法分析这个报错，给出证据和置信度
say.note: 产出带 file:line 的证据与置信等级

say.text: 这几个假设哪个最可能是根因？按证据强度排序
say.note: 它会按置信度等标准做仲裁

howto.what_en: Claude debugs complex issues with competing hypotheses: generates hypotheses across 6 failure-mode categories, investigates in parallel, collects file:line evidence, assigns confidence levels, arbitrates the root cause, and validates the fix.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a bug has multiple plausible root causes, initial debugging attempts haven't found the issue, or the problem spans multiple modules and needs systematic root cause analysis.

say_en.text: This bug may have several causes — help me investigate the root causes in parallel.
say_en.note: It generates competing hypotheses and gathers evidence.

say_en.text: Analyze this error with competing hypotheses, giving evidence and confidence levels.
say_en.note: You get file:line evidence and confidence levels.

say_en.text: Which of these hypotheses is most likely the root cause? Rank by evidence strength.
say_en.note: It arbitrates using criteria like confidence level.
